supporting_pages.title: "Update backup/recovery appliances \_|\_ Backup and DR \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: Navigate to the Manage > Appliances page and check the appliance management console and backup/recovery appliance connection status in the Connectivity Status column.

For example, if N (11.0.17) is the latest version available, and a backup/recovery appliance is on unsupported version N-2 (11.0.15), then auto patch upgrades only move the appliances to N-1 (11.0.16), and not to the latest version (11.0.17).
